# gbarecomp-keyinput-v1
# Control twin of probe-hop-right.keyinput.txt: the SINGLE changed variable is the
# tapped bit. probe taps A (0x01 -> 0x03EE); this file taps Start (0x08 -> 0x03E7).
# A and Start are adjacent GBA keyinput bits (A=0x01, B=0x02, Select=0x04,
# Start=0x08, Right=0x10). gSubReason 0x03000C3C := 7 is requested by
# gf_tfunc_0801B958 when bit 0x8 of 0x03001848 is set; 0x03001848 is the
# pressed-edge word built by gf_tfunc_08000954 from REG_KEYINPUT 0x04000130.
